title: Welcome to the static blog
content:
This blog runs behind a CGNAT VPS gateway — self-hosted, no open ports, zero-trust.

There is no backend at all: nginx serves the xore//blog frontend plus this posts.json. Publishing a post means editing posts.json and reloading — the whole 'CMS' is a text file.

Every other example in cgnat/examples serves the exact same blog with a real backend (Flask, Express, Redis, ASP.NET Core + Postgres, Go, Rust) — same frontend, same API contract, different storage story.

title: How this reaches the internet
content:
Browser → Cloudflare (WAF + TLS) → VPS Traefik → socat bridge → WireGuard tunnel → home server socat → nginx.

The home connection sits behind CGNAT, so nothing is port-forwarded: the home server dials out to the VPS over WireGuard and the VPS relays traffic back through the tunnel.

The old CGNAT documentation pages still live under /docs/ on this site.

title: This draft never shows up
content: Posts with "published": false are filtered out by the frontend — same behavior as the drafts feature in the backend-powered examples.
